title: Number of 1 Bits
summary: Create a function that accepts a positive integer and outputs the count of bits set to one in its binary form.
statement: Create a function that accepts a positive integer and outputs the count of bits set to one in its binary form.
hints: Subtracting one changes the lowest set bit and the zeros below it.
AND n with n-1 to clear exactly its lowest set bit.
Repeat that clearing operation until n is zero, counting each iteration.
The number of iterations equals the number of set bits.
editorial: The operation n & (n-1) clears one set bit without affecting the higher set bits. Count how many times it can be applied before the value becomes zero. This visits only set bits; the independent oracle counts ones in the binary string representation.

tests.explanation: 11 is binary 1011, with three set bits.
128 is binary 10000000, with one set bit.
